run_dataloader_benchmark: run a dataloader benchmark measuring items processed and elapsed time for a given iterable
run_exp_torch_imagenet: run PyTorch DataLoader benchmark on ImageNet with configurable workers, batching, normalization, and GPU transfer
run_exp_spdl_imagenet: run SPDL Pipeline benchmark on ImageNet with configurable workers, batching, normalization, and GPU transfer
run_entrypoint_comparison: run the CLI entrypoint to compare PyTorch DataLoader versus SPDL Pipeline throughput across worker counts
run_run_test_benchmark: run benchmark tests across multiple worker counts for both PyTorch and SPDL data loading approaches
